prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid Selection Layout for Pet Picker: Rebuild the pet choice screen into a 2x2 grid layout displaying pet avatars and personalities side by side. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and a long median decision time (89s), indicating decision friction.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Summary Screen: Insert a new screen right after pet selection showing an expanded preview and trait list of the chosen pet before photo customization. (why: Users take up to 1017s mean time on adoption; a intermediate confirmation screen reinforces choice confidence.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In To Final Onboarding Step: Move the sign-in prompt to after pet waiting screen, right before the final home introduction. (why: Moving account sign in after users build emotional connection and complete pet setup reduces pre-adoption drop-off.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive First Desktop Interaction Flow: Transform the home intro screen into a full-stage layout with interactive welcome mascot call-to-actions. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and users take a mean time of 5815s; interactive initial prompts drive fast completion.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Layout for Path Selection: Switch the choose path screen layout to spotlight style focusing on one path at a time. (why: Choose path has a mean time of 514s, indicating potential option overload on first launch.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign In Persistence Warning: Add a prominent account persistence hint on the sign-in screen explaining account syncing. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Progress Indicator: Enable visible progress bar and time estimate on the waiting screen while desktop pet resources load. (why: Median waiting time in home step is 201s (mean 2336s), and 3 support emails reported desktop pet launch stalls.)
7: [adoption, incentive] Certificate Adoption Verification Badge: Display an official adoption badge graphic on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point (60.9% conversion); visual rewards celebrate user completion.)
8: [home, notification] Onboarding Completion Ready Alert: Enable desktop notification trigger on the waiting screen to alert users when asset loading completes. (why: The mean time spent on home/waiting step is 2336s, showing users minimize or leave the app during loading.)
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Headline: Update home intro headline and body text to explain basic desktop controls (right-click to interact or hide). (why: Support received 3 emails post-onboarding asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)

scores.note: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%); grid layout reduces decision friction.
